method: In-session static review (5 subagent fan-out failed with 429 rate limit; consolidated work proceeded in main session). 7-lens scan per module: registration parity, call-vs-handler, classifier-vs-handler, event emit-vs-subscribe, config-reader parity, path/route parity, stub far-end sweep. Read-only — no edits made during review phase.

fix_plan.summary: Drop 7 dead pub fns + 1 dead enum variant across gateway core: AgentInstance::list_runs (no callers), debug::parse_tool_call_params (no callers), SubscriptionManager::{get_filter,set_filter} (no callers; live path uses granular add_patterns/get_patterns), TopicFilter::with_subscriptions (test-only), GatewayEventBus::with_capacity (test-only), GatewayEvent::RuntimeInstallProgress (struct published via TopicEvent directly, not via enum), wizard::{handle_answer,handle_next} demoted to private (only used in same-file wrap closure)

channel_registry::{register_factory,create_channel} are dead per documented design (production routes via config-driven create_channel_from_config). CUT pending: confirm no in-flight branch adds dynamic factory registration.

Drop 8 dead pub APIs: GenerationProviderRegistry::{config_name_for_canonical,get_or_err} (test-only / no callers), parse_generation_requests/has_generation_requests (test-only; the [GENERATE:...] syntax is not wired), and demote 4 Builder types (FalProviderBuilder, MidjourneyProviderBuilder, OpenAiCompatProviderBuilder, ReplicateProviderBuilder) to pub(crate) — used internally by the factory but exposed needlessly.

DECIDE/CUT-or-defer on 5 wiring gaps. Two real dormant features: (a) per-persona provider override — PersonaConfig.provider field honored by executor.rs:107-108 but with_provider_registry is never wired at startup (src/bin/aleph-server/commands/start/mod.rs:3033 only calls .with_coordinator_visible + .with_history_window). (b) StateDatabase turn persistence — both with_database builders never invoked, persist_turn silently no-ops via self.db.clone(). Three smaller dead APIs: GroupChatOrchestrator::all_sessions (test-only), GroupChatSession::build_history_text (helper-of-helper), StateDatabase::{get_group_chat_session_owner, list_active_group_chats} (zero callers). Recommend CUT for the DB methods + all_sessions + build_history_text; DECIDE for the two dormant features (per-persona provider + DB persistence).

DECIDE on GuardrailRegistry::{disable_all,enable_all} runtime kill-switch — designed but no admin RPC exists to invoke it. CUT the four is_* accessors on GuardrailDecision (test-only pub API) by demoting to pub(crate). CUT one stale doc-comment TODO in decision.rs:34.

deferred_decisions.reason: GroupChatExecutor::with_database + GroupChatOrchestrator::with_database are pub builders never invoked at startup. persist_turn silently no-ops via self.db.clone(). Without CONNECT (wire StateDatabase at startup), these are dead scaffolding. Recommend CUT but defer to confirm no turn-persistence roadmap.

Persona::provider field honored by GroupChatExecutor::resolve_provider only if with_provider_registry is called at startup — it isn't, so per-persona provider override is dead. The painless-wire heuristic argues CUT (no example config uses it), but removing the persona field would be a breaking change to the public config schema.

GuardrailRegistry::{disable_all,enable_all} are real designed runtime kill-switches (master spec §Stage 5) with no admin RPC. CUT = delete both methods + AtomicBool + the four short-circuit checks; CONNECT = add a `gateway.guardrails.disable` admin RPC + Panel toggle. Product call.

channel_registry::{register_factory,create_channel} are documented as 'internal code reaches factories through handlers::channel::create_channel_from_config'. The factories pattern is a future plugin-extensibility hook. Confirm no in-flight branch adds dynamic factory registration before CUT.

wiring_health.src/goal: CLEAN — all 23 GoalStore methods + all pursuit.rs fns + all types.rs public types have live consumers. Module is the canonical backing store for goal state and is fully wired.
wiring_health.src/generation: CLEAN — factory at providers/factory.rs covers 22 distinct provider_type strings, all 20 provider types are reachable via config. 4 dead pub APIs and 2 test-only fns are the only findings.
wiring_health.src/guardrails: CLEAN — three trait surfaces (Input/Output/ToolCall) all consumed at documented harness callsites (think.rs:349/850/1294, act.rs:38/813, think.rs:1212). The build_guardrail_registry at orchestrator_init.rs:518 wires the registry via [guardrails].enabled OR [secrets_config].{virtual_keys, custom_leak_patterns}.
wiring_health.src/group_chat: TWO-WIRE-CUT — the system is fully functional for the LLM-facing path (parser → handler → executor → response) but has two dormant features: per-persona provider override and DB turn persistence. Both were designed but never wired at startup. Recommend DECIDE: either wire them at startup or cut the scaffolding.
wiring_health.src/gateway: STRONGEST-DISCIPLINE — method_census.rs mechanically enforces registration-vs-classification parity at test time (the audit playbook's recommended compile-time-equivalent guard). Every registered RPC has a Class::Admin / Class::Open ruling; the census sweeps .register("..." and register_handler!(server, "..." patterns and fails if any new RPC is registered without a census entry or vice versa. The 8 findings are off the RPC boundary (dead struct methods, dead enum variants, test-only pub APIs).
